verses.greek: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα περιεπάτει ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ, οὐ γὰρ ἤθελεν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ περιπατεῖν, ὅτι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀποκτεῖναι.
verses.literal: And after these things was walking the Jesus in the Galilee not for He was desiring in the Judea to walk because were seeking Him the Jews to kill.
verses.dgt: After these things Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he did not wish to walk in Judea because the Jews were seeking to kill him.

verses.greek: ἦν δὲ ἐγγὺς ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἡ σκηνοπηγία.
verses.literal: Was now near the feast of the Jews the of Booths.
verses.dgt: Now the Jewish Feast of Booths was near.

verses.greek: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ· Μετάβηθι ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ὕπαγε εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν, ἵνα καὶ οἱ μαθηταί σου θεωρήσουσιν σοῦ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιεῖς·
verses.literal: Said therefore to Him the brothers of Him do depart from here and do go into the Judea so that also the disciples of You will see of You the works that You are doing
verses.dgt: So his brothers said to him, “Leave here and go to Judea, so that your disciples also may see the works you are doing.

verses.greek: οὐδεὶς γάρ τι ἐν κρυπτῷ ποιεῖ καὶ ζητεῖ αὐτὸς ἐν παρρησίᾳ εἶναι· εἰ ταῦτα ποιεῖς, φανέρωσον σεαυτὸν τῷ κόσμῳ.
verses.literal: No one for anything in secret does and seeks himself in public to be If these things You do do show Yourself to the world.
verses.dgt: For no one does anything in secret while seeking to be known publicly. If you do these things, show yourself to the world.”

verses.greek: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν.
verses.literal: Not even for the brothers of Him were believing in Him.
verses.dgt: For not even his brothers were believing in him.

verses.greek: λέγει οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὁ καιρὸς ὁ ἐμὸς οὔπω πάρεστιν, ὁ δὲ καιρὸς ὁ ὑμέτερος πάντοτέ ἐστιν ἕτοιμος.
verses.literal: Says therefore to them the Jesus The time the for Me not yet is come the but the time the of you always is ready.
verses.dgt: So Jesus said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

verses.greek: οὐ δύναται ὁ κόσμος μισεῖν ὑμᾶς, ἐμὲ δὲ μισεῖ, ὅτι ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ πονηρά ἐστιν.
verses.literal: Not is able the world to hate you Me myself however it hates because I myself bear witness concerning it that the works of it evil are.
verses.dgt: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify about it that its works are evil.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς ἀνάβητε εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν· ἐγὼ οὐκ ἀναβαίνω εἰς τὴν ἑορτὴν ταύτην, ὅτι ὁ ἐμὸς καιρὸς οὔπω πεπλήρωται.
verses.literal: You yourselves do go up to the feast I myself not am going up to the feast this for the My time not yet has been fulfilled.
verses.dgt: You go up to the feast. I am not going up to this feast yet, because my time has not yet been fulfilled.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα δὲ εἰπὼν αὐτὸς ἔμεινεν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ.
verses.literal: These things now having said He himself He remained in the Galilee.
verses.dgt: After saying these things, he remained in Galilee.

verses.greek: Ὡς δὲ ἀνέβησαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν, τότε καὶ αὐτὸς ἀνέβη, οὐ φανερῶς ἀλλὰ ὡς ἐν κρυπτῷ.
verses.literal: When however had gone up the brothers of Him to the feast then also He himself went up not openly but as in secret.
verses.dgt: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not openly but as in secret.

verses.greek: οἱ οὖν Ἰουδαῖοι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ καὶ ἔλεγον· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἐκεῖνος;
verses.literal: The therefore Jews were seeking Him at the feast and were saying Where is He?
verses.dgt: So the Jews were looking for him at the feast and saying, “Where is he?”

verses.greek: καὶ γογγυσμὸς περὶ αὐτοῦ ἦν πολὺς ἐν τοῖς ὄχλοις· οἱ μὲν ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἀγαθός ἐστιν, ἄλλοι δὲ ἔλεγον· Οὔ, ἀλλὰ πλανᾷ τὸν ὄχλον.
verses.literal: And murmuring about Him there was much among the crowds. Some indeed were saying that Good He is Others however were saying No but He deceives the people.
verses.dgt: And there was much murmuring about him among the crowds. Some were saying, “He is good,” while others were saying, “No, but he deceives the people.”

verses.greek: οὐδεὶς μέντοι παρρησίᾳ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων.
verses.literal: No one however publicly was speaking about Him because of the fear of the Jews.
verses.dgt: Yet no one was speaking openly about him because of fear of the Jews.

verses.greek: Ἤδη δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς μεσούσης ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐδίδασκεν.
verses.literal: Now also of the feast being in the middle went up Jesus into the temple and was teaching.
verses.dgt: When the feast was already halfway over, Jesus went up into the temple and began teaching.

verses.greek: ἐθαύμαζον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι λέγοντες· Πῶς οὗτος γράμματα οἶδεν μὴ μεμαθηκώς;
verses.literal: Were marveling then the Jews saying How this one writings knows not having studied?
verses.dgt: The Jews were amazed, saying, “How does this man know writings when he has not studied?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν· Ἡ ἐμὴ διδαχὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὴ ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με·
verses.literal: Answered therefore them the Jesus and said: the My teaching not is of Myself but of the One who having sent Me
verses.dgt: So Jesus answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but belongs to the one who sent me.

verses.greek: ἐάν τις θέλῃ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιεῖν, γνώσεται περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς πότερον ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν ἢ ἐγὼ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ λαλῶ.
verses.literal: If anyone shall desire the will of Him to do he will know concerning the teaching whether from the God it is or I myself from Myself speak.
verses.dgt: If anyone wants to do his will, he will know concerning the teaching whether it is from God or whether I speak from myself.

verses.greek: ὁ ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ λαλῶν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἰδίαν ζητεῖ· ὁ δὲ ζητῶν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτὸν οὗτος ἀληθής ἐστιν καὶ ἀδικία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν.
verses.literal: The one from himself speaking the glory the their own seeks the One however seeking the glory of the One who having sent Him He true is and unrighteousness in Him not is.
verses.dgt: The one who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but the one who seeks the glory of the one who sent him is true, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

verses.greek: Οὐ Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν νόμον; καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ποιεῖ τὸν νόμον. τί με ζητεῖτε ἀποκτεῖναι;
verses.literal: Not Moses has given to you the law? and no one of you keeps the law! Why Me do you seek to kill?
verses.dgt: Did not Moses give you the law? Yet none of you keeps the law. Why are you seeking to kill me?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ὄχλος· Δαιμόνιον ἔχεις· τίς σε ζητεῖ ἀποκτεῖναι;
verses.literal: Answered the crowd A demon You have who You seeks to kill?
verses.dgt: The crowd answered, “You have a demon! Who is seeking to kill you?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἓν ἔργον ἐποίησα καὶ πάντες θαυμάζετε.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus and said to them One work I did and all you marvel.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “I did one work, and all of you are amazed.

verses.greek: διὰ τοῦτο Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὴν περιτομήν— οὐχ ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Μωϋσέως ἐστὶν ἀλλʼ ἐκ τῶν πατέρων— καὶ ἐν σαββάτῳ περιτέμνετε ἄνθρωπον.
verses.literal: Because of this: Moses has given you the circumcision — not that of the Moses it is but of the fathers — also on Sabbath you circumcise a man.
verses.dgt: For this reason Moses gave you circumcision—not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers—and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath.

verses.greek: εἰ περιτομὴν λαμβάνει ἄνθρωπος ἐν σαββάτῳ ἵνα μὴ λυθῇ ὁ νόμος Μωϋσέως, ἐμοὶ χολᾶτε ὅτι ὅλον ἄνθρωπον ὑγιῆ ἐποίησα ἐν σαββάτῳ;
verses.literal: If circumcision receives a man on Sabbath so that not shall be broken the law of Moses with Me myself are you angry because entirely a man sound I made on the Sabbath?
verses.dgt: If a man receives circumcision on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses is not broken, are you angry with me because I made an entire man well on the Sabbath?

verses.greek: μὴ κρίνετε κατʼ ὄψιν, ἀλλὰ τὴν δικαίαν κρίσιν κρίνετε.
verses.literal: Not do judge according to appearance but the righteous judgment do judge.
verses.dgt: Do not judge according to appearance, but judge with righteous judgment.”

verses.greek: Ἔλεγον οὖν τινες ἐκ τῶν Ἱεροσολυμιτῶν· Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὃν ζητοῦσιν ἀποκτεῖναι;
verses.literal: Were saying therefore some of those of Jerusalem Not this is he whom they seek to kill?
verses.dgt: Then some of the people of Jerusalem were saying, “Is this not the one they are seeking to kill?

verses.greek: καὶ ἴδε παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖ καὶ οὐδὲν αὐτῷ λέγουσιν· μήποτε ἀληθῶς ἔγνωσαν οἱ ἄρχοντες ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ χριστός;
verses.literal: And behold publicly He speaks and no thing to Him they say. otherwise Truly have recognized the rulers that this is the Christ?
verses.dgt: And look, he is speaking openly, and they say nothing to him. Have the rulers really recognized that this is the Christ?

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ τοῦτον οἴδαμεν πόθεν ἐστίν· ὁ δὲ χριστὸς ὅταν ἔρχηται οὐδεὶς γινώσκει πόθεν ἐστίν.
verses.literal: But this man we know from where He is The however Christ whenever He may come no one knows from where He is.
verses.dgt: But we know where this man is from. Yet when the Christ comes, no one knows where he is from.”

verses.greek: ἔκραξεν οὖν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ λέγων· Κἀμὲ οἴδατε καὶ οἴδατε πόθεν εἰμί· καὶ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλήλυθα, ἀλλʼ ἔστιν ἀληθινὸς ὁ πέμψας με, ὃν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε·
verses.literal: Cried out therefore in the temple teaching the Jesus and saying Me you know and you know from where I am and of Myself not I have come but is true the One having sent Me whom you yourselves not know
verses.dgt: Then Jesus cried out in the temple as he taught, saying, “You know me, and you know where I am from. Yet I have not come from myself; the one who sent me is true, whom you do not know.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ οἶδα αὐτόν, ὅτι παρʼ αὐτοῦ εἰμι κἀκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν.
verses.literal: I myself know Him because from Him I am and He Me sent.
verses.dgt: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

verses.greek: ἐζήτουν οὖν αὐτὸν πιάσαι, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὴν χεῖρα, ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: They were seeking therefore Him to take but no one laid upon Him the hand because not yet had come the hour of Him.
verses.dgt: So they were seeking to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him because his hour had not yet come.

verses.greek: ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου δὲ πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν, καὶ ἔλεγον· Ὁ χριστὸς ὅταν ἔλθῃ μὴ πλείονα σημεῖα ποιήσει ὧν οὗτος ἐποίησεν;
verses.literal: Out of the crowd now many believed in Him and were saying The Christ When He may come Surely not more signs will He do than this man has done?
verses.dgt: But many from the crowd believed in him and were saying, “When the Christ comes, will he do more signs than this man has done?”

verses.greek: Ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τοῦ ὄχλου γογγύζοντος περὶ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα, καὶ ἀπέστειλαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὑπηρέτας ἵνα πιάσωσιν αὐτόν.
verses.literal: Heard the Pharisees the crowd murmuring about Him these things and sent the chief priests and the Pharisees officers that they may seize Him.
verses.dgt: The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things about him, and the chief priests and Pharisees sent officers to seize him.

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἔτι χρόνον μικρὸν μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με.
verses.literal: Said therefore the Jesus Yet time a little with you I am and I go to the One having sent Me.
verses.dgt: So Jesus said, “I am with you a little while longer, and then I go to the one who sent me.

verses.greek: ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετε, καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν.
verses.literal: You will seek Me and not will find and where am I myself you yourselves not are able to come.
verses.dgt: You will seek me and will not find me, and where I am, you cannot come.”

verses.greek: εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς ἑαυτούς· Ποῦ οὗτος μέλλει πορεύεσθαι ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐχ εὑρήσομεν αὐτόν; μὴ εἰς τὴν διασπορὰν τῶν Ἑλλήνων μέλλει πορεύεσθαι καὶ διδάσκειν τοὺς Ἕλληνας;
verses.literal: Said therefore the Jews among themselves Where He is about to go that we ourselves not will find Him? Surely to the Dispersion among the Greeks is He about to go and to teach the Greeks?
verses.dgt: Then the Jews said among themselves, “Where is this man about to go that we will not find him? Is he about to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

verses.greek: τίς ἐστιν ὁ λόγος οὗτος ὃν εἶπε· Ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετε, καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν;
verses.literal: What is the word this that He said You will seek Me and not will find and Where am I myself you yourselves not are able to come?
verses.dgt: What is this saying that he spoke: ‘You will seek me and will not find me,’ and, ‘Where I am, you cannot come’?”

verses.greek: Ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ μεγάλῃ τῆς ἑορτῆς εἱστήκει ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἔκραξεν λέγων· Ἐάν τις διψᾷ ἐρχέσθω πρός με καὶ πινέτω.
verses.literal: In now the last day the great day of the feast had stood the Jesus and cried out saying If anyone shall thirst he should come to Me and should drink.
verses.dgt: Now on the last and great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, “If anyone thirsts, let him come to me and drink.

verses.greek: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμέ, καθὼς εἶπεν ἡ γραφή, ποταμοὶ ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας αὐτοῦ ῥεύσουσιν ὕδατος ζῶντος.
verses.literal: The one believing in Me myself even as has said the Scripture: Rivers out of the belly of him will flow of water living.
verses.dgt: The one who believes in me, just as the Scripture has said, ‘From within him will flow rivers of living water.’”

verses.greek: τοῦτο δὲ εἶπεν περὶ τοῦ πνεύματος οὗ ἔμελλον λαμβάνειν οἱ πιστεύσαντες εἰς αὐτόν· οὔπω γὰρ ἦν πνεῦμα, ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐδέπω ἐδοξάσθη.
verses.literal: This now He said concerning the Spirit which were about to receive those having believed in Him not yet for was the Spirit because Jesus not yet was glorified.
verses.dgt: He said this about the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were going to receive. For the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.

verses.greek: Ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου οὖν ἀκούσαντες τῶν λόγων τούτων ἔλεγον· Οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης·
verses.literal: from the crowd therefore having heard the words these were saying This is truly the Prophet.
verses.dgt: Therefore, when some from the crowd heard these words, they were saying, “This truly is the Prophet.”

verses.greek: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ χριστός· οἱ δὲ ἔλεγον· Μὴ γὰρ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ὁ χριστὸς ἔρχεται;
verses.literal: Others were saying This is the Christ Those however were saying Surely not for out of the Galilee the Christ comes?
verses.dgt: Others were saying, “This is the Christ.” But others were saying, “The Christ does not come from Galilee, does he?

verses.greek: οὐχ ἡ γραφὴ εἶπεν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Δαυίδ, καὶ ἀπὸ Βηθλέεμ τῆς κώμης ὅπου ἦν Δαυίδ, ἔρχεται ὁ χριστός;
verses.literal: Surely the Scripture has said that out of the seed of David and from Bethlehem the village where was David comes the Christ
verses.dgt: Has not the Scripture said that the Christ comes from the offspring of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

verses.greek: σχίσμα οὖν ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ διʼ αὐτόν.
verses.literal: A division therefore occurred in the crowd because of Him.
verses.dgt: So a division arose in the crowd because of him.

verses.greek: τινὲς δὲ ἤθελον ἐξ αὐτῶν πιάσαι αὐτόν, ἀλλʼ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας.
verses.literal: Some now were desiring of them to seize Him but no one laid on Him the hands.
verses.dgt: Some of them wanted to seize him, but no one laid hands on him.

verses.greek: Ἦλθον οὖν οἱ ὑπηρέται πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ Φαρισαίους, καὶ εἶπον αὐτοῖς ἐκεῖνοι· Διὰ τί οὐκ ἠγάγετε αὐτόν;
verses.literal: Came therefore the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees and said to them that Because of why not did you bring Him?
verses.dgt: Then the officers came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, “Why did you not bring him?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ ὑπηρέται· Οὐδέποτε ἐλάλησεν οὕτως ἄνθρωπος.
verses.literal: Answered the officers Never spoke like this a man
verses.dgt: The officers answered, “Never has a man spoken like this.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν αὐτοῖς οἱ Φαρισαῖοι· Μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς πεπλάνησθε;
verses.literal: Answered therefore them the Pharisees Surely not also you yourselves have been deceived?
verses.dgt: So the Pharisees answered them, “You have not also been deceived, have you?

verses.greek: μή τις ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων ἐπίστευσεν εἰς αὐτὸν ἢ ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων;
verses.literal: Surely not any of the rulers has believed on Him or of the Pharisees?
verses.dgt: None of the rulers or the Pharisees has believed in him, has he?

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ ὁ ὄχλος οὗτος ὁ μὴ γινώσκων τὸν νόμον ἐπάρατοί εἰσιν.
verses.literal: But the crowd this the not knowing the law cursed are.
verses.dgt: But this crowd that does not know the law is accursed.”

verses.greek: λέγει Νικόδημος πρὸς αὐτούς, ὁ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν πρότερον, εἷς ὢν ἐξ αὐτῶν·
verses.literal: Says Nicodemus to them the one having come to Him former one being of them
verses.dgt: Nicodemus, the one who had come to him earlier and who was one of them, said to them,

verses.greek: Μὴ ὁ νόμος ἡμῶν κρίνει τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσῃ πρῶτον παρʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ γνῷ τί ποιεῖ;
verses.literal: Surely not the law of us does judge the man only unless it shall hear first from him and may know what he does?
verses.dgt: “Our law does not judge a man unless it first hears from him and learns what he is doing, does it?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶ; ἐραύνησον καὶ ἴδε ὅτι ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας προφήτης οὐκ ἐγείρεται.
verses.literal: They answered and they said to him Surely not also you yourself from the Galilee are? do search and do see that out of the Galilee a prophet not is raised.
verses.dgt: They answered him, “You are not also from Galilee, are you? Search and see that no prophet is raised from Galilee.”

verses.greek: ⟦καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: And went each to the house his
verses.dgt: And each one went to his own house.
notes: John 7:53–8:11 is bracketed in SBLGNT because of its well-known textual history. It is retained because it is present in the SBLGNT source.
